description: Synthetic POST of an ES/Madrid payment to the api-gateway, exercising the sanctions-aml-service path. Unlike TE-05 (a GB payment), this body carries customer_country=ES so it degrades for REAL under the 'madrid-payment-degradation' chaos scenario, which arms SLOW_LOCATION_* on sanctions-aml-service (~2s latency + RegionalDependencyError 5xx for ES). Feeds the 'AML synthetic latency p95 (ThousandEyes)' KPI on the sanctions-aml-service ITSI service. Bound to the metrics (path-vis) stream's testMatch. Added during engagement handover (cgorman).
